svg.title: Atlantic North Equatorial Countercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 1100 km. Declared 42 W to 32 W western summer study reach: one editor-selected NECC connection inside the source regional surface-flow context. Branch assignment and joining remain review gates. Excludes independent northern-branch geometry, upstream NBC retroflection, equatorial ESC and eastern-basin continuation. Not a whole-current length or sum of branches. All latitude gates and bends are editorial. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate 42 W to 32 W western summer study reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Dimoune et al. (2023); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
